description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waththala, Waththala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
